summary_1line: Hearing a deceptive cry, Sita angrily urges Lakshmana to aid Rama, accusing him of betrayal until he reluctantly leaves her alone.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sita, trembling and furious in the forest hut, points accusingly at Lakshmana while he stands with folded hands in anguish.
Lakshmana hesitates at the edge of the forest clearing, looking back anxiously at Sita before departing to seek Rama.
Sita stands alone outside the hermitage amid dark forest shadows after Lakshmana leaves, foreshadowing danger.
